document.abstract: (1.1) Specifications — This practice specifies the dimensions of transverse cemented splices on 16-mm and 8-mm type R motion-picture film. (1.2) Types — Two types of splices are specified: a laboratory splice for professional applications and a projection splice for release prints and consumer or amateur reversal films. (1.3) Excepted splicers — It is not intended that this practice be prejudicial to diagonal, scarf, or tape splicers.
